data: What is the approximate percentage of female employment in 1990?

The graph shows the percentage of female employment over time. The y-axis represents the percentage employed, ranging from 27% to 35%. The x-axis represents years, with 1990 being the most recent point on the graph. The line representing female employment starts at approximately 28% in 1950 and increases steadily until reaching around 34% in 1990. Therefore, the approximate percentage of female employment in 1990 is 34%.
